# TeslaX

> TeslaX is an unofficial portfolio concept of a Tesla website by denysovski. It is not affiliated with Tesla, Inc.; prices, dates, stock and the store are demo data, and no form sends anything.

The homepage is a long scroll about the Model S Plaid: interior, gaming, safety, electric architecture, a model showcase, software, Tesla Energy, performance, ownership costs, a demo-drive form, updates, an FAQ and future features. Sub-pages cover every link in the navigation.
